source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Fuel Tank and Exhaust Systems, p.8-4

procedures.title: Fuel tank: remove and install
steps: Remove the gas cap and the filler neck boot on top of the tank, and disconnect the drain line (see figure 6 in the manual).
Raise the car on a hoist.
Take the spare tire off the carrier (see figure 7 in the manual).
Unbolt and remove the spare tire carrier.
Loosen the U clamps and separate the exhaust systems at the transmission support.
Remove the rear muffler brackets at the frame and slide the exhaust systems rearward.
Disconnect the gauge unit wires and fuel lines and drain the tank.
Remove the tank support-to-frame bolts and the support.
Lower the tank, rotating it toward the front of the car.
